syllabus.title: AITS:3 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• Gravitation, Mechanical Properties of Solids, Mechanical Properties of Fluids, Thermal Properties of Matter + AITS-2.

📌 CHEMISTRY
• Equilibrium, P-block Element (Group 13 and 14), Organic Chemistry: IUPAC Nomenclature, Organic Chemistry: Isomerism + AITS-2.

📌 BOTANY
• Morphology of Flowering Plants, Anatomy of Flowering Plants + AITS-2.

📌 ZOOLOGY
• Locomotion & Movement, Neural Control & Coordination + AITS-2.
